Junte-se à CHANDON, uma Maison de vinhos espumantes renomada mundialmente, com uma rica herança e um espírito inovador. Como parte do prestigiado grupo Moët Hennessy (MH) e do conglomerado de luxo LVMH, a CHANDON oferece um ambiente de trabalho excepcional onde a paixão pela excelência e a busca pela inovação se encontram. Nossos colaboradores são a essência do nosso sucesso, e valorizamos um ambiente seguro, saudável e sustentável.      Responsabilidades: Garantir a aplicação adequada das exigências do BRGAAP, IFRS, CPC e do GAAP do Grupo em transações contábeis e relatórios financeiros. Executar e apoiar o processo de fechamento financeiro mensal, garantindo que todos os custos incorridos sejam devidamente registrados, os lançamentos contábeis (diários) sejam precisos, as conciliações de contas sejam concluídas no prazo e os relatórios financeiros sejam preparados conforme os prazos estabelecidos. Preparar e revisar conciliações do razão geral (General Ledger) e lançamentos contábeis, garantindo precisão, consistência e conformidade com as normas contábeis. Garantir a integridade e a manutenção adequada do razão geral e do plano de contas, incluindo a classificação e o registro corretos das transações. Preparar análises detalhadas de contas e lançamentos contábeis de suporte para transações complexas ou não rotineiras. Realizar o tratamento contábil, a validação e a conciliação de impostos, incluindo IPI, ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL, PIS, COFINS, ISS e outros tributos aplicáveis, garantindo que os créditos fiscais sejam devidamente calculados, fundamentados e reconhecidos de forma apropriada nos registros contábeis, considerando a reforma tributária e as aplicações de sistemas. Preparar o cálculo de custo médio e de estoques de acordo com os Princípios Contábeis. Apoiar as atividades de contabilidade do ativo imobilizado, incluindo revisões fiscais e de vida útil, além de avaliações de terrenos. Preparar e analisar as contas " B. Home" e as respectivas conciliações contábeis. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de sistemas, iniciativas de automação, controles e práticas de negócios para aumentar a eficiência e a confiabilidade dos dados. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!        Key Responsibilities   ● Pickup Operations Management: Oversee daily pickup operations across Brazil, ensuring sellers are collected within SLA and operational targets. Coordinate pickup flows with logistics providers, monitor execution quality, and proactively address operational risks, delays, and capacity constraints.   ● Supplier Coordination & Performance Management: Manage relationships with pickup service providers and carriers, conducting regular operational reviews, aligning volume forecasts, and ensuring compliance with company standards and KPIs. Drive accountability and corrective actions when performance deviations occur.   ● Data Analysis & Decision Making: Analyze operational data, pickup performance, seller behavior, capacity utilization, and cost indicators to support strategic and operational decision-making. Develop reports and dashboards to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.   ● Operational Planning & Execution: Support short-, medium-, and long-term pickup planning, balancing operational efficiency, service quality, and cost optimization. Ensure fast escalation, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.   ● Field Operations & Seller Experience: Conduct field visits with logistics providers and sellers to validate operational standards, improve pickup experience, and ensure operational compliance. Maintain close visibility of frontline operational challenges.   ● Strategic Projects & Network Development: Support strategic initiatives related to pickup network expansion, operational model optimization, collection point management, and logistics performance improvement projects.      Requirements   ● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related fields.   ● Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce, express logistics, or first mile operations.   ● Strong knowledge of pickup operations, logistics supplier management, operational KPIs, and field execution.   ● Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make operational decisions based on data, performance indicators, and operational trends.   ● Operational & Analytical Profile: Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced environment.   ● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong ability to identify root causes, manage operational risks, and implement corrective and preventive actions.   ● Supplier Management Experience: Experience coordinating logistics providers, conducting performance reviews, and driving operational improvements.   ● Project Management Skills: Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional logistics projects.   ● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to engage directly with field operations, logistics providers, and sellers to ensure operational excellence.   ● Portuguese fluency is mandatory.   ● Intermediate English is required; fluent English is considered a strong plus.   ● Spanish and/or Mandarin are considered a plus. title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
Confira a vaga para Data specialist (with advanced english) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.    About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.        Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure Open AI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry. Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (Share Point, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros) Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. title: Product designer
description:
Confira a vaga para Product designer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Who We Are  We believe in a world where research never sleeps.       Most companies struggle to understand their customers. Not because they don't try, but because market research can be siloed, slow, and incomplete.      Discuss is changing that.       Our mission is to elevate human understanding at scale by building the always-on solution that transforms market research, making it continuous and intelligent while keeping humans at the center. We’ve built a comprehensive, innovative, set of AI-driven solutions that have made us only one of two companies named a Leader in the Forrester Wave Q1 2026 Experience Research Platforms Report. Discuss has earned top rankings by G2 for Best Results, Customer Relationships, Usability, and more for 14 consecutive quarters. We’re not slowing down any time soon.       In the age of AI, scaling empathy without losing human understanding matters. Solving this problem makes what we do every day both interesting and rewarding. Our team believes in doing the right thing, even when it's inconvenient. We build tools that customers love because we listen to them. We believe in transparency and we own the results together.       Discuss is a team of 200+ employees in 23 countries, serving 900 customers worldwide. We hire people who care about the humans on the other side of the data and want to help build something that hasn't existed before.      If you want your work to make the distance between organizations and the people they serve feel, for once, like it isn't there, we'd love to talk.      About this role  We're rebuilding how design happens at Discuss: an AI-assisted, code-native process where prototypes are real running code, feedback happens on live URLs instead of static frames, and a shared component system keeps design and engineering from drifting apart.      We're looking for an AI Forward Product Designer who's excited to work this way, someone comfortable moving fast with AI tools while keeping a high bar for craft, structure, and accessibility.      You'll own design work end to end across the pipeline: framing the problem, wireframing the flows, generating high-fidelity prototypes as code, running feedback on live previews, and closing the loop into our component library.      How this role works You'll own solutions in your own area of the product, working closely with a product manager and engineers, and may float between teams as coverage is needed. You'll collaborate weekly with the design director and the other design ICs for team alignment and growth.    What you'll do Take features from problem to prototype. Help frame the problem and write lightweight specs, then move into wireframes and high-fidelity work. Generate high-fidelity, interactive prototypes as real code (React, shadcn, Tailwind) using AI tools like Claude Code/Design, working against our shared design tokens and components. Wireframe in low fidelity first, focusing on structure and flow before visual polish, covering every real state and not just the happy path. Run feedback on live prototypes hosted on Vercel. Gather comments, triage them, and fold decisions back into the work and the spec. Keep the design system honest. Contribute components and tokens back to our shared shadcn registry and its hosted component reference (Storybook), so what's designed matches what ships. Work in the open, in version control. Your specs, flows, wireframes, and prototypes live as files in the repo, reviewed like code. Design with light and dark mode and accessibility built in from the start, not bolted on.    What we're looking for Around 4 years of product design experience. Strong product design fundamentals: interaction design, layout, information hierarchy, and a good eye for visual craft. Strong taste and design judgment. You can tell what's working and what isn't, edit toward the better version, and raise the quality bar without needing every decision spelled out. Comfort with AI-assisted design tools and a willingness to work in a convention-driven way, where shared rules guide and review the work. Enough technical fluency to work in code-based prototypes. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable reading and adjusting React and Tailwind, and working in a repo (Git, pull requests, markdown). Experience with component-based design systems and design tokens. Solid grasp of accessibility (WCAG basics, keyboard nav, contrast, semantics). Clear communication with product and engineering. You can write a tight spec and explain a design decision.    Nice to have Experience running or designing for usability tests. Familiarity with Figma as a fine-tuning and handoff tool (we use it selectively, not as our source of truth). Experience with Storybook, or documenting a design system for other teams to build against. Exposure to MCP-based or other shared-system tooling across multiple products or teams. Experience designing for B2 B or B2 B2 C Saa S products.    How is success measured in this role Speed from wireframe approved to stakeholder sign-off. You help shrink that gap. Handoff fidelity. The work you promote into the component library holds up against production code without heavy rework. Quality of feedback. Prototypes are real and clickable enough that stakeholders react precisely, early, and often. Product outcomes. Work you ship moves adoption metrics (via Pendo) in the intended direction, and usability issues don't show up as a recurring theme in post-launch feedback or drive avoidable rework.

Pesquisa de Mercado & Curadoria de Pauta ( Market Research ) Conduzir desk research , leitura de relatórios setoriais e conversas exploratórias com executivos para mapear dores e prioridades de cada indústria. Identificar hot topics , tendências emergentes e casos práticos de sucesso que atraiam a atenção de decisores. Estruturar a grade do evento: desenhar títulos atrativos, resumos provocativos e definir formatos ideais (palestras magnas, painéis de debate, roundtables ). #### B. Atração e Gestão de Palestrantes ( Speaker Recruitment ) Mapear e prospectar ativamente líderes C-Level, especialistas e autoridades via Linked In, e-mail e telefone. Fazer o pitch de valor da MARTIN Summits, negociando a participação de palestrantes de renome (maioria sem cachê/participação editorial). Gerenciar toda a jornada do palestrante: briefing da sessão, alinhamento de expectativas, coleta de biografias, fotos e aprovação de apresentações. #### C. Alinhamento Multidisciplinar ( Cross-functional ) Comercial / Patrocínio: Garantir a integração ética e qualificada de patrocinadores na grade, preservando a autoridade técnica do evento. Marketing: Fornecer ganchos editoriais, destaques de palestrantes e argumentos de valor para campanhas de atração de público qualificado. Operações & Palco: Apoiar a execução no dia do evento, coordenando a sala VIP de palestrantes, tempos de fala ( timekeeping ) e transição das sessões. --- 3. Requisitos e Qualificações Formação: Graduação em andamento ou concluída em Jornalismo, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Comunicação Social, Marketing, Letras ou áreas correlatas. Comunicação Executiva: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (fluência para conversar de igual para igual com diretores e C-Levels). Idiomas: Inglês intermediário a avançado (leitura confortável de relatórios globais e facilidade para abordar executivos internacionais). Organização e Autonomia: Domínio de ferramentas de produtividade (Google Workspace/Excel, Notion/Trello/Asana). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia em feiras/eventos B2 B, prospecção ativa (SDR/comercial), redação econômica ou assessoria de imprensa. --- 4. Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills) Resiliência e Persuasão: Não se intimidar com a hierarquia corporativa e ter habilidade para contornar objeções de agenda de executivos. Curiosidade Intelectual: Interesse genuíno por negócios, finanças, tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade. Atenção aos Detalhes: Capacidade de acompanhar prazos rígidos, grafia correta de cargos/nomes e padrões de qualidade visual. --- 5. Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs)   | KPI | Objetivo |   | :--- | :--- |   | Pipeline de Palestrantes | Cumprimento do cronograma de confirmações de C-Levels por etapa do evento. |   | Relevância e Diversidade da Grade | Equilíbrio de empresas de grande porte representadas e diversidade nos painéis. |   | SLA de Materiais | Coleta de 100% de bios, fotos e apresentações dentro dos prazos pré-evento. |   | NPS do Conteúdo | Nota de satisfação dos participantes em relação à qualidade técnica da conferência. |   ---

description:

About i QIYI    i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.      Role purpose    Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.      Key responsibilities   1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.    Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Online teacher - whole child education | iws online school
description:
Empresa está contratando Online teacher - whole child education | iws online school em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.      At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects , and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.    We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.    You may have many years of teaching experience.    You may have relatively little.    That is not the first thing we look at.      We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.    What is much harder to train is:   Genuine care for children Empathy and emotional awareness Positive energy and warmth Strong character and responsibility Curiosity and willingness to learn A real desire to make a difference in a child’s life    The role    You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.    This includes:   Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons Teaching your specialist subject effectively Building strong relationships with students Understanding each child as an individual Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families Participating in training and continuous professional development    Who we are looking for    We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.    What matters most is not simply what you teach.    It is how you make children feel while they are learning.    We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.    There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.    We take that responsibility seriously.    Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.    If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.    When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.    Not your best lesson.    The child.

Valorizamos cada indivíduo, independentemente de sua etnia, cor, raça, religião, origem, idade, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra condição. Todas as nossas vagas estão acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência.      Se identificou com os nossos valores? title: Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled
description:
Confira a vaga para Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Emperor Rentals is a U. S. vacation-rental and real-estate business seeking a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager based in Brazil for a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time. You will work with our Portuguese-speaking team and communicate clearly in English with U. S. management and our external accountant.      This is a very hands-on individual-contributor role. You will personally perform day-to-day bookkeeping and financial housekeeping: clean up transactions, organize receipts, reconcile accounts, prepare owner statements, and produce recurring reports. You will own follow-through from source documents to accurate books and completed reporting. You will also improve these financial workflows using AI.      COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE    USD $250 per week. Required schedule: FULL-TIME, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time (New York time, following Eastern daylight-saving changes). You must be available for this fixed schedule; general time-zone overlap is not sufficient. Confirm your availability and acceptance of this weekly budget in your proposal. Long-term collaboration is intended, subject to performance and mutual agreement.      WHAT YOU WILL OWN   - Daily Quick Books Online bookkeeping across separate legal entities: bank/card feeds, accurate categories, property classes, receipts, and an aged exception list.   - Bank and credit-card reconciliations to actual statements, with every difference explained and supporting documents retained.   - Owner Rez accounting: reconcile property expenses and owner statements to Quick Books, distinguish reimbursements from service income, and prepare weekly property-management transfer schedules for approval.   - Keep guest/owner trust funds, operating cash, intercompany transfers, owner distributions, and business income correctly separated.   - Reconcile Airbnb, Vrbo, , Stripe and other payouts, fees, commissions, refunds and chargebacks to bookings and bank deposits.   - Prepare monthly owner statements and property-level reports, apply review corrections promptly, and track completion through final approval.   - Support weekly payroll and contractor-payment reconciliation across time/work records, payment-provider records and the bank, including fees and failed or duplicate payments.   - Retrieve mortgage and utility support, prepare principal/interest/escrow allocations, and maintain property-specific records.   - Deliver monthly P& L, balance-sheet support, reconciliation schedules and a clear list of unresolved items. Support W-9/1099 preparation under the external accountant's approved instructions.      AI-ASSISTED ACCOUNTING   - Use approved AI tools to help extract invoice data, propose transaction classifications, compare exports, investigate differences, draft reports and document procedures.   - Build repeatable spreadsheet and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.   - Verify every AI-generated calculation, classification and proposed entry against source documents. Keep a clear audit trail and follow company data-access policies.   - Retain personal responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the books, and obtain required approval before posting adjustments or releasing payments.      REQUIRED EXPERIENCE   - At least 3 years of hands-on U. S. bookkeeping/accounting and Quick Books Online, with ownership of reconciliations, monthly close and financial reporting.   - Either practical experience using AI tools in finance/accounting, OR a strong willingness to learn and consistently use AI in our financial workflows. Prior AI expertise is not required; careful verification, curiosity and adoption of our tools are required.   - Strong bank reconciliation, double-entry accounting, balance-sheet cleanup and multi-entity experience.   - Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling large exports.   - Professional Portuguese and strong written/spoken English. Based in Brazil for team collaboration and working-hour alignment.   - Ability to spot duplicates, missing receipts, incorrect periods, wrong properties and unsupported classifications without waiting for the owner to find them.   - Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and willingness to use Hubstaff for agreed work-time reporting.      STRONGLY PREFERRED    Property management, vacation rentals, real estate or trust/owner accounting; Owner Rez; OTA/Stripe payout reconciliation; Quick Books Pro Advisor certification; familiarity with Slack, Notion, Operto or similar operations tools. An accounting degree is welcome.      HOW WE DEFINE GOOD WORK    Accurate reconciliations, clear evidence and dependable completion dates. Review new bank-feed items each business day and process supported items within one business day where possible. Escalate missing information with an owner and due date. Reconcile before declaring work complete. Flag unclear instructions, explain accounting implications, document decisions and improve repetitive workflows. Payment release and tax decisions remain subject to management/accountant approval.      TO APPLY   1. Describe your U. S. Quick Books and property-management experience, including the number of entities/accounts you managed.   2. Explain how you would handle a property repair paid by Operations and later reimbursed from owner funds without double-counting income.   3. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered, how you proved it and how you prevented recurrence.   4. Explain your monthly-close checklist and how you track missing receipts and unresolved differences.   5. Describe how you currently use AI, or confirm your willingness to learn and use AI in our financial workflows. Explain how you would check its output for accuracy.   6. Confirm your location in Brazil, English/Portuguese proficiency, availability for the full-time Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern schedule, and acceptance of USD $250 per week.      Please share only anonymized examples with no client financial details. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a separately agreed paid practical exercise using sample data. We value sound judgment, careful work and clear communication.

title: Partnerships manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Partnerships manager em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership    You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.    Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.    That's where you come in.      The Role — In Plain English    You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.    This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.    Your week might look like this:   Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing.  You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.      What Makes This Different    Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.    You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.    Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.      You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in Saa S, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you    What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job    If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.    Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

Key Responsibilities  Verification Lifecycle Ownership Own and execute the complete verification lifecycle from system-level concept through tape-out and post-silicon support. Develop functional coverage models and assertion-based verification. Perform formal verification activities including property checking. Implement and support power-aware verification flows using UPF .  Design Analysis Collaboration Collaborate with product designers to understand functionality and protocol requirements. Review product designs to identify potential failure points. Develop verification methodologies based on design requirements and risk areas.    Automation Process Improvement Develop automation solutions to improve verification efficiency. Optimize testing processes and verification workflows. Plan and execute structured test sequences and validation activities.    Quality Documentation Conduct quality control inspections and verification sign-off activities. Mandatory Requirements Strong experience in IC verification, particularly digital verification. Experience with System Verilog and UVM-based verification methodologies . Experience developing verification testbenches and coverage models. Experience with assertion-based verification and formal verification concepts. Understanding of pre-silicon verification processes. Experience collaborating with IC design teams. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.    Preferred Qualifications Experience with UPF power-aware verification flows . Experience with digital power IP verification. Experience developing verification automation frameworks. Experience supporting tape-out and post-silicon validation activities. title: Product analyst - vmake · brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Product analyst - vmake · brazil em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Why We Need You    We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.      You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.      What You’ll Do Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.    Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within Saa S, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.    Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Program manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Program manager em taubaté. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility?    Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere.    Main missions:   Manages and delivers the project (OP and Customer) objectives and deliverables. Responsible for the project profitability Manages the complete development budget and cash flow for the entire project. Delivers a non-event launch of the project into production Represents OP at the customer and represents the customer in OP Promote EHS and quality requirements internally and externally Project Definition Ensures the OPTIMAP Project plan and total development budget is in accordance with the agreed Customer Statement of Work and validated project scope. Leads the core team member's OPTIMAP work packages and their agreed development budgets, in agreement with the project objectives and the project scope Establishes and manages the master project timing plan and consolidates negotiated planning of each core team member ensuring it conforms to the customer and OPTIMAP timing plans Responsible for the profitability of the project and sets the core team members' targets to work towards in line with the project objectives. (Development hours, PRU, investments, cash flow, Costs of Non-Quality). Follows and applies the direction of the division cascaded by the Program director. At the end of the project assesses the status against the original project objectives and feeds back lessons learned. Actions management / Reporting / Risks In line with the OPTIMAP Project Plan, consolidates the global project status and ensures that the core teams are accountable for their status for the deliverables completion in the division Information Systems. Manages and identifies deviations from the planned Project Plan and validates the actions proposed by the core team members to realign. Responsible for organizing project meetings, project reviews and end of phase reviews with all core team members to review project status and project action plan follow-up. Prepares and presents the gateway reports to the OPTIMAP committee and, in anticipation of the gate event, issues the gate validation report. Consolidates the threats and opportunities of each department, prioritizes and manages the action plan to respond to the risks throughout the project phases. Responsible for the financial control / reporting of the project budget using the standard BG tools to consolidate and reporting cash flow and profitability to program reviews. Split of the project development budget by department and delegation to the core team members for their financial control / reporting (excluding payment/expenditure authorization). Manages the scope change (internal / external) process and ensures the project budget is updated (hours, investment and production costs). Manages project development expenditure versus the planned budget, identifies any deviation (hours, investments and production costs), and takes appropriate actions to realign. Manages the project cash flow, including tooling and other costs. Only project team members can authorize payment to suppliers respecting OPs procedures and terms. Responsible for ensuring the contribution and actions of all project team members to achieve a non-event launch. Challenges that the optimum technical and manufacturing solutions / choices are made by the project team to meet the design to cost project objectives. Provides periodic reporting to the program director, plant director, department managers and sales director highlighting the key project progress and risks through the program review process. Follows the project reporting of each core team member to manage the escalation process of issues and risks and the achievement of their project actions. Team / people Ensures the coordination of the project team, communication management, project meeting organization, conflict resolution and building an effective team. Ensures the project team applies the methodology of development - OPTIMAP through adequate division Information Systems In line with the project development budget identifies the resource needs, skills and locations to meet the project objectives. Contributes to the annual assessment process of the core team members. Responsible to ensure the project team apply company standards and best practices as defined by each department to maximise the productivity of the development budget. Ensures the health and safety of the project team and the respect of the environment Applies and respects the procedures of the engineering and plant sites and the responsibility for control or destruction of project parts and waste. Customer Is OP's accountable representative of the project for the customer With the support of the PQL ensures the actions of the customer APQP process and final customer validation files (PPAP, PSW...) are cascaded and managed through the project team. Responsible for the coordination / management of all the project team members' communications to the customer and ensure the core team members take their responsibility in front of the customer. Is responsible for ensuring that all the customer deliverables (customer approval, APQP, build deliveries etc.) are managed and delivered by the project team and reports the progress to the customer in line with the agreed Statement Of Work. Identifies to the Commercial Project Manager and the customer, customer scope changes to the agreed Customer Statement of Work in accordance to the budget of development (hours, travel costs, costs / hour) and the OPTIMAP project plan. Supports the Commercial Project Manager in the negotiation of customer scope changes. Department Participates in the establishment and the delivery of the department progress plans Participates in the continuous improvement of the departments, organization and methodologies, with actions of lessons learned, best practices and productivity. Cascading / be a mentor for another junior program manager.  At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward.    Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You'll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow's automotive industry.    Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions.    With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R& D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.    O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.    Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável. O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento e detalhamento de produtos e componentes, além da estruturação de documentação técnica e materiais que assegurem padronização e suporte à aplicação em campo.    Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e forte domínio técnico para transformar requisitos em soluções viáveis, conduzir detalhamentos de projeto com precisão e garantir a qualidade da entrega por meio da elaboração de manuais técnicos e padronizações. Também será essencial apoiar a capacitação da equipe técnica, fortalecendo a transferência de conhecimento e a consolidação de boas práticas de engenharia. Se você tem afinidade com desenvolvimento de produto, documentação técnica e inovação aplicada ao agronegócio, esta oportunidade é para você. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.    Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.    Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.    Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.    Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.      Analista De Garantida Da Qualidade e Excelência Operacional      Atribuições Atuar como guardião do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ), garantindo conformidade com a ISO 9001 e demais requisitos corporativos. Desenvolver modelos, padronizar e controlar documentos corporativos (procedimentos, especificações técnicas, P& IDs, folhas de dados, memoriais de cálculo, listas técnicas, templates...). Gerenciar Relatórios de Não Conformidade (RNC), ações corretivas e preventivas, auditorias internas, gestão de riscos e lições aprendidas. Desenvolver e gerir indicadores de qualidade (não conformidades, tempo médio de tratamento de RNCs, Performance de fornecedores, conformidade documental, e demais KPIs do SGQ. Integrar Engenharia, Suprimentos, Obras, Fabricação, Comissionamento e Assistência Técnica, assegurando a rastreabilidade das informações e a governança dos processos.    Qualificações Superior em Engenharia, Qualidade ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em Gestão da Qualidade, processos e documentação técnica em empresas EPC ou projetos industriais. Conhecimento em ISO 9001 (participação em implantações anteriores será considerado como diferencial). Experiência em gestão de indicadores, análise de dados, Excel Avançado e elaboração de relatórios executivos. Experiência com sistemas ERP, GED e Power BI Desejável conhecimento em Lean, gestão de riscos e metodologias de melhoria contínua. title: Arquiteto de soluções
description:
Confira a vaga para Arquiteto de soluções em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções / Desenvolvedor AWS para fazer parte do time!      Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor / Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software e atuação comprovada no desenho de arquiteturas de soluções AWS. O foco principal é construir, evoluir e sustentar aplicações em produção, combinando qualidade de código, visão arquitetural e domínio prático de cloud.    Este profissional atuará de forma hands-on em decisões de arquitetura, implementação de componentes críticos, integração de serviços AWS, automação de infraestrutura, observabilidade, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos.    A função é de contribuição individual e não inclui responsabilidade formal de Tech Lead ou gestão de pessoas. Experiência em discovery, pré-vendas e comunicação técnica com clientes será valorizada como diferencial e utilizada pontualmente.      Desenvolvimento de software   • Projetar, desenvolver, testar, revisar e manter aplicações, APIs, microsserviços, integrações e componentes críticos em produção.   • Aplicar clean code, SOLID, design patterns, tratamento de erros, testes automatizados, segurança e documentação.   • Atuar com Python, Node.js, Type Script, Go ou linguagem equivalente, demonstrando profundidade em pelo menos uma stack de produção.   • Realizar code reviews, troubleshooting e análise de performance, contribuindo tecnicamente com o time sem assumir liderança formal de pessoas.   • Modernizar aplicações legadas e avaliar a adoção pragmática de serverless, containers, microsserviços e eventos.      Arquitetura de soluções   • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções seguras, escaláveis, resilientes, observáveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.   • Criar diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, dados, rede, segurança e implantação com ícones AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.   • Registrar decisões com Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), incluindo contexto, alternativas, trade-offs e consequências.   • Definir disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup, disaster recovery e prontidão para produção.   • Avaliar serviços e revisar soluções com base no AWS Well-Architected Framework, equilibrando operação, segurança, confiabilidade, performance, custo e sustentabilidade.   • Construir provas de conceito e apoiar o detalhamento técnico e o handoff das soluções.      Cloud, Dev Ops e operação   • Implementar infraestrutura com Terraform, módulos reutilizáveis, gestão de estado, pipelines e controles para Infrastructure as Code.   • Criar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, testes automatizados, controles Dev Sec Ops e estratégias seguras de deployment e rollback.   • Implementar observabilidade com logs, métricas, traces, alarmes, dashboards e SLI/SLO.   • Investigar incidentes e falhas complexas, participar de análise de causa raiz e implementar ações preventivas.   • Aplicar segurança por design, least privilege, gestão de segredos, criptografia, proteção de perímetro e rastreabilidade.   • Otimizar continuamente custo, performance, capacidade e confiabilidade.      Apoio técnico a clientes e pré-vendas - Desejável   • Participar pontualmente de discovery técnico, workshops, estimativas, provas de conceito e apresentações para clientes.   • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em alternativas técnicas, premissas, riscos, estimativas de esforço e custos AWS.   • Explicar decisões e trade-offs com clareza para públicos técnicos, executivos e comerciais.   • Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs e questionários técnicos ou de segurança quando necessário.      Serviços e Conhecimentos Relevantes    Desenvolvimento e arquitetura    APIs REST/Graph QL, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, serverless, eventos, cache, consistência, idempotência e resiliência.    Computação    EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e seleção entre compute gerenciado, serverless e Kubernetes.    Redes e entrega    VPC, subnets, Security Groups, Route 53, ELB, Cloud Front, API Gateway, Private Link, Transit Gateway, VPN e conectividade híbrida.    Dados e integração    S3, RDS/Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Kinesis ou MSK; Glue, Athena e Redshift como diferenciais.    Segurança e identidade    IAM, IAM Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, Cloud Trail, AWS Config, Guard Duty, Security Hub e least privilege.    Governança    AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs, landing zones, contas multi-account, tagging, políticas e segregação de ambientes.    Observabilidade e resiliência    Cloud Watch, X-Ray/Open Telemetry, logs, métricas, traces, AWS Backup, alta disponibilidade, RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação.    Automação e entrega    Terraform, módulos, state, pipelines Ia C, Git, CI/CD, testes, deployment, Systems Manager e noções de Cloud Formation ou CDK.    Fin Ops e IA    Cost Explorer, Budgets, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans e alocação de custos; Bedrock, RAG, agentes e guardrails como diferenciais.      Profundidade Esperada    Espera-se domínio prático de desenvolvimento de software e conhecimento aprofundado em pelo menos quatro dos domínios AWS acima. Não é necessário dominar todos os serviços, mas é essencial selecionar alternativas, explicar trade-offs e implementar soluções sustentáveis em produção.      Competências Comportamentais   • Comunicação oral e escrita clara, objetiva e adaptada a públicos técnicos, executivos, comerciais e clientes.   • Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar qualidade, prazo, segurança, risco, operação e custo.   • Autonomia, pragmatismo, colaboração e forte senso de ownership sobre entregas e resultados.   • Capacidade de trabalhar com ambiguidades, investigar problemas complexos e tomar decisões fundamentadas.   • Abertura a feedback, disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e maturidade para discutir alternativas técnicas.   • Orientação ao cliente e compreensão do impacto das escolhas técnicas no negócio.      Requisitos Obrigatórios   • Experiência relevante com desenvolvimento de aplicações em produção e atuação prática em AWS.   • Experiência comprovada desenhando ou participando ativamente de arquiteturas de soluções AWS.   • Profundidade em Python, Node.js/Type Script, Go ou linguagem equivalente, incluindo testes e práticas de qualidade.   • Experiência com APIs, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, serverless ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.   • Experiência com Terraform, CI/CD, Git, containers, observabilidade e troubleshooting em produção.   • Conhecimento de redes, segurança, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação de desastres na AWS.   • Capacidade de produzir diagramas, ADRs, documentação técnica e estimativas de implementação.   • Certificação AWS válida de nível Associate ou superior.      Vem fazer parte do time! Aguardamos a sua inscrição!!

title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Controller
description:
Nova oportunidade para Controller em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About MAVI      MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.      We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.      The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.      Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.      The Role      We are seeking an experienced Controller to own the accounting function of a high-growth US company, working remotely from LATAM.      This is the senior accounting seat in the business. You will be accountable for the integrity of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of the company for its audit. Where the company has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a control environment that exists in principle rather than in practice, an intercompany process that produces a different answer each quarter — you will be the person who rebuilds them.      You will work directly with the CEO, the finance leadership, and the department heads whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask.      Because you will be the most senior accounting person in the company and located outside the United States, the role calls for someone who operates well with autonomy, communicates proactively rather than on request, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture without a layer above them to catch what falls through.      What You'll Own      The Close and the Financial Statements      The close. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.      The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of leadership, auditors, and the board.    Final review. Hold final review authority over general ledger activity, journal entries, account reconciliations, and fixed assets.      Technical accounting. Research, document, and conclude on technical positions — revenue recognition, leases, equity, accruals, and capitalisation — and maintain the memoranda that support them.      Multi-entity accounting. Own consolidation across the group structure, including intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.      Controls, Policy, and Audit      Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to the company's stage, and enforce them once established.      Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and SOPs that allow the function to operate without depending on any single individual.      Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.      Tax coordination. Coordinate US federal, state, and local tax compliance with external CPA firms, and own the accounting inputs those firms depend on.      Accounting Operations      The transactional cycle. Own AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.      Balance sheet integrity. Ensure reconciling items are resolved rather than carried forward, and that every balance has support a reviewer can follow.      Cash reporting. Maintain accurate cash reporting and reconciliation, and provide leadership with a reliable view of position and movement.      Business partnership. Provide FP& A and department leaders with the reporting packages, KPIs, variance analysis, and root-cause explanation that budgeting and forecasting depend on.      Team and Systems      The accounting team. Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team, and manage external accounting and bookkeeping partners against agreed standards and deadlines.      Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.      Process design. Build accounting processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and cycle time as the company grows, rather than processes that break at the next stage.      What We're Looking For     8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of an accounting team Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842); familiarity with stock-based compensation (ASC 718) is an advantage Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Quick Books Online, or Xero, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , Rippling, Gusto, or Flo Qast Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; Power BI or comparable reporting tools an advantage Experience acting as the senior accounting partner to executive leadership, including presenting results and defending conclusions Comfort operating within a lean team, with the seniority to own the function and the willingness to prepare the entry yourself when circumstances require it Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field    Preferred     CPA, Contador Público, CRC-registered Contador, CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded Saa S, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR Board, lender, and management reporting experience Exposure to US multi-state tax, international entities, or transfer pricing is welcome    Who This Role Is For      This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own a function outright rather than administer one part of it.      You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you, and you are equally credible in a room with a CEO, an auditor, and a junior accountant.      Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.      Why Join Through MAVI      Own an entire accounting function, end to end, with direct exposure to founders and senior leadership      Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's    Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities      Sit close to the decisions that depend on your numbers, with visible impact on the outcome      Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI    Work remotely with US-based leadership, in substantial overlap with the US business day    Receive MAVI's support throughout placement, onboarding, and the engagement that follows      Work Arrangement      This is a fully remote role. You will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners, and you will be placed with a single client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts.      Candidates based in LATAM will maintain near-full overlap with the US business day. Candidates based in India should expect a structured afternoon-to-evening schedule providing a firm overlap against US Eastern hours.

title: Technical sales engineer

This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches. Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers. Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions. Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.
