Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives. Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows. Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring. Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps. Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.    Pre-Sales Support     Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria. Participate in RFP and RFI processes. Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements. Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials. Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.    Business Development and Market Engagement     Contribute to territory planning and account strategies. Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content. Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities. Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required. Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.    Internal Collaboration     Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams. Provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to support product development. Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities. Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.    What we’re looking for      Mandatory Technical Experience     Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:  Ingest    Encoding and transcoding    Statistical multiplexing, or statmux    Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR    Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT    Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH    Primary distribution    Cable distribution   Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations. Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows. Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions. Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria. Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations. Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals. Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies. Experience with live and on-demand video architectures. Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.    Desirable Technical Experience     Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models. Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI. Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI. Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud. Knowledge of broadcast and media standards, including:  SMPTE ST 2110    SCTE-35    SCTE-224   Experience with Content Delivery Networks. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. Experience with video compression, packaging, encoding, DRM, and content delivery. Understanding of cloud-based media workflows and recording solutions. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.    Business and Customer Skills     Ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience discussing both technical requirements and business outcomes with customers. Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills. Commercial awareness and an understanding of Saa S business models. A customer-focused approach supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Experience working with partners, resellers, systems integrators, or other ecosystem stakeholders is advantageous.    Differentiators      The following experience is not required but would be considered an advantage:     Participation in large-scale projects as a Solutions Architect or in a similar technical leadership role. Programming or scripting skills. Experience representing an organization at trade shows as an exhibitor, speaker, or technical presenter. Cloud architecture certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or another recognized provider. Additional training or certifications in video technologies, broadcast engineering, networking, or cloud architecture. title: Senior accountant
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior accountant em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.      The Opportunity      As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.      This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.      What You Will Own     Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close    What We're Looking For     5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, Toast, or similar) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant Ability to work with US time zone overlap    Why Join MAVI?     Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles Flexible remote work with global impact Compensation in USD

title: Analista de recursos humanos junior
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de recursos humanos junior em pouso alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.      Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.      Objetivo do cargo    Atuar na gestão operacional dos processos de ponto eletrônico, garantindo a qualidade das informações, cumprimento dos prazos, atendimento aos colaboradores e gestores, além da correta integração das informações com a folha de pagamento.      Principais responsabilidades Realizar a administração operacional do sistema de Ponto Eletrônico ADP, garantindo cadastros, parametrizações básicas e manutenção das informações dos colaboradores. Acompanhar diariamente as marcações de ponto, identificando inconsistências e realizando as tratativas necessárias. Executar ajustes de ponto conforme políticas internas e aprovações dos gestores. Apoiar o processo de fechamento mensal do ponto, garantindo a entrega das informações dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Realizar atendimento aos colaboradores, gestores e áreas de RH sobre dúvidas relacionadas a: Marcações de ponto; Ajustes de jornada; Banco de horas; Horas extras; Escalas e horários. Realizar controles e acompanhamentos operacionais por meio de relatórios e indicadores. Apoiar análises de divergências entre ponto eletrônico e folha de pagamento. Acompanhar chamados junto ao fornecedor ADP, garantindo o tratamento das demandas. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas ao controle de jornada. Contribuir com melhorias de processos, automações e padronização das rotinas do HRSS.  Requisitos    Formação: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas.  Conhecimentos técnicos: Experiência recente com processos de Ponto Eletrônico em ambiente corporativo. Conhecimento do sistema ADP (diferencial experiência com ADP Workforce/Kairos). Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista relacionada à jornada de trabalho. Excel mínimo intermediário (filtros, fórmulas, tabela dinâmica, PROCV/PROCX). Vivência com atendimento ao cliente interno e processos de Serviços Compartilhados (HRSS).  Competências esperadas: Organização e atenção aos detalhes; Perfil analítico e facilidade com números; Boa comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes públicos; Capacidade de cumprir prazos e trabalhar com alto volume de informações; Senso de dono e foco na melhoria contínua.    Descrição da Empresa      A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

title: Analista de finanças e controladoria
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de finanças e controladoria em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senioridade: Pleno/Sênior    Modelo: contratação PJ    Remuneração: R$ 8.000 por mês    Formato: remoto    Localização: Brasil ou exterior, sujeito à viabilidade contratual e à sobreposição com o horário comercial de Brasília    Início: preferencialmente em outubro de 2026, com flexibilidade para uma transição responsável    Reporte direto: Head de Finanças    Equity: elegibilidade ao plano de stock options em estruturação      A MISSÃ O DA POSIÇÃ O      Buscamos uma pessoa que goste de entender os números até a origem e de deixar cada processo mais forte para o mês seguinte.      Você trabalhará diretamente com o Head de Finanças e terá como missão tornar-se referência da Pix Force em números, controles e processos, conectando ERP, contabilidade, folha de pagamento, bancos, contratos e projetos para produzir análises confiáveis, rastreáveis e úteis à tomada de decisão.      Esta não é uma vaga restrita à atualização de planilhas. Precisamos de alguém que perceba quando algo não fecha, investigue a causa, organize as evidências, proponha o tratamento correto, acompanhe a correção, documente a decisão e reduza o risco de recorrência.      Buscamos um profissional pleno forte ou em início de senioridade, capaz de assumir entregas de ponta a ponta.      SOBRE A PIX FORCE      Fundada em 2016, a Pix Force é uma deep tech brasileira especializada em Inteligência Artificial e Visão Computacional aplicadas a operações industriais.      Transformamos imagens, vídeos e documentos em informações confiáveis para aumentar a eficiência, preservar ativos e proteger pessoas. Na prática, ensinamos máquinas a enxergar o que os olhos humanos não alcançam — em ambientes em que um detalhe despercebido pode gerar perdas, paradas ou riscos à vida.      Nossas plataformas centrais são o Pix Safety, para segurança operacional; o Pix Asset, para inspeção e inteligência de ativos; e o Idexa, para processamento inteligente de documentos. O Pix Labs atua como nosso motor de P& D e de inovação aplicada.      Fomos reconhecidos sete vezes como Top #1 em Inteligência Artificial e Visão Computacional no ranking 100 Open Startups e desenvolvemos mais de 100 projetos. Somos mais de 60 pessoas no Brasil e no exterior.      Nossa tecnologia já foi aplicada em projetos com organizações como Petrobras, Shell, Equinor, Vibra Energia, CEMIG, Vale, Arcelor Mittal, Rumo, Suzano e Siemens.      O Idexa processa cerca de 70 mil páginas por mês em uma operação da Vibra Energia, na qual o tempo de espera foi reduzido em 85%. Em um projeto offshore com a Equinor, a janela de inspeção foi reduzida de três meses para 19 dias. E estes são só dois dos nossos centenas de cases de sucesso.      POR QUE ESTA VAGA EXISTE      A Pix Force combina projetos de P& D, provas de conceito, contratos com escopo definido e receitas recorrentes de software. Essa complexidade exige uma área financeira capaz de integrar contabilidade, caixa, contratos, projetos e planejamento.      Estamos fortalecendo a gestão, a governança e os controles e evoluindo processos manuais e dispersos para uma operação mais documentada, reproduzível, auditável e automatizada.      Você não entrará apenas para operar o que já está pronto, mas também para ajudar a construir a infraestrutura financeira da próxima fase.      PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES      Fechamento e Controladoria     • Participar diretamente do fechamento contábil e gerencial mensal.   • Extrair, organizar e conferir informações do ERP, da contabilidade, da folha de pagamento, dos bancos e dos controles internos.   • Conciliar informações financeiras, contábeis e gerenciais e investigar as diferenças até a origem.   • Analisar balancete, razão, diário, lançamentos, DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa.   • Questionar classificações, competências, provisões, centros de custo, saldos e variações relevantes.   • Acompanhar as correções junto à contabilidade externa e às áreas internas até a conclusão.      FP& A e suporte à decisão     • Manter e aprimorar o P& L gerencial da companhia e dos projetos.   • Elaborar análises de realizado versus orçamento e de realizado versus forecast.   • Apoiar o orçamento, as projeções financeiras, os cenários de caixa e o capital de giro.   • Analisar receitas, custos, despesas, margens e as principais variações.   • Preparar materiais executivos para o Head de Finanças, a administração e os investidores.   • Apoiar análises de Saa S, de unit economics, de rentabilidade e de due diligence para fundraising.      Projetos, P& D e operação financeira     • Acompanhar receitas, custos, horas, margens e desvios de contratos e de projetos.   • Apoiar a governança financeira, as alocações de projetos e as prestações de contas dos projetos de P& D.   • Apoiar contas a pagar e a receber, faturamento, cobrança, conciliações bancárias e projeção de caixa.   • Interagir com a contabilidade externa e com as demais áreas.      Processos, dados e automação     • Organizar bases, arquivos, versões, memórias de cálculo e evidências.   • Documentar regras, exceções, decisões, responsáveis e aprovações.   • Melhorar planilhas, controles e rotinas financeiras.   • Ajudar a tornar o fechamento mais determinístico, rastreável e automatizado.   • Utilizar IA de maneira responsável, com confidencialidade, revisão humana e rastreabilidade.      COMO SERÁ MEDIDO O SUCESSO      Nos primeiros 90 dias, esperamos que a pessoa compreenda o calendário e as fontes, assuma conciliações e rotinas com supervisão limitada, produza memórias reproduzíveis, investigue diferenças com autonomia crescente e se torne um backup efetivo para processos críticos.      Em até 12 meses, esperamos que conduza frentes relevantes do fechamento, P& L, caixa, orçamento e forecast; entregue análises, melhorias e automações; mantenha trilhas auditáveis; apoie diligências; e se torne referência da empresa em números e processos.      REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS     • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou em área relacionada.   • Experiência relevante em Controladoria, FP& A, Contabilidade Gerencial, Planejamento Financeiro ou áreas correlatas. A profundidade das responsabilidades será mais importante do que a simples contagem de anos.   • Experiência prática em fechamento contábil ou gerencial e em conciliações. É necessário saber executar, conferir e investigar — não apenas acompanhar relatórios preparados por terceiros.   • Conhecimento sólido de balancete, razão, diário, DRE, balanço patrimonial, fluxo de caixa, competência, provisões, reclassificações, centros de custo e análise de variações.   • Excel avançado de verdade: tratamento de bases de dados, fórmulas de busca e de soma condicional, tabelas estruturadas e dinâmicas, rastreamento de fórmulas e conciliações auditáveis.   • Experiência com ERP e compreensão do fluxo de uma transação até o relatório.   • Capacidade de identificar diferenças, buscar evidências e acompanhar a solução até o encerramento.   • Organização rigorosa, comunicação clara, cumprimento de prazos e discrição em relação a informações confidenciais.   • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto e para reuniões com sobreposição relevante ao horário comercial de Brasília.      DIFERENCIAIS     • Empresas de tecnologia, Saa S, scale-ups ou ambientes de rápido crescimento.   • Controladoria por contratos ou projetos.   • Projetos de P& D, subvenções, incentivos ou prestação de contas.   • Lucro Real ou Sociedade Anônima.   • Orçamento, forecast, modelagem financeira e unit economics.   • Auditoria, Big Four, controles internos ou trilhas de evidência.   • Valuation, fundraising, M& A ou due diligence, quando combinados com disposição para execução.   • Inglês avançado ou fluente.   • Uso responsável de IA em análises, documentação, automação e produtividade financeira.   • Experiência com ERP Omie.      O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS      Valorizamos profissionais que distinguem fatos, hipóteses e opiniões; discordam com respeito e evidências; mudam de posição diante de evidências melhores; comunicam riscos cedo; assumem os problemas que identificam; e entendem que velocidade sem controle não é eficiência.      Esta vaga provavelmente não será adequada para quem procura uma função exclusivamente estratégica, não deseja executar rotinas financeiras, depende de relatórios prontos, aceita ajustes sem compreender sua causa, não gosta de documentar o próprio trabalho ou prefere ambientes em que todos os processos já estejam estruturados.      O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRARÁ     • Trabalho diretamente com o Head de Finanças, o time financeiro, todas as áreas da empresa e os sócios.   • Participação efetiva na construção da área.   • Contato com P& D, projetos, Po Cs e Saa S.   • Problemas analíticos e operacionais relevantes.   • Responsabilidades crescentes à medida que a qualidade das entregas melhora.   • Uma empresa cuja tecnologia gera impacto no mundo real.      Não prometemos uma estrutura perfeita. Prometemos problemas relevantes, aprendizado e espaço para deixar uma marca.      REMUNERAÇÃ O E STOCK OPTIONS      A remuneração será de R$ 8.000 por mês, por meio de contratação via PJ.      Além da remuneração mensal, a posição será elegível ao plano de stock options que a companhia está estruturando, e que inclusive você poderá ajudar a estruturar. Quantidade, vesting, exercício e demais condições serão definidos nos instrumentos do plano e estarão sujeitos às aprovações aplicáveis. Como o plano ainda está em estruturação, esses detalhes não estão disponíveis nesta etapa. A participação não representa garantia de liquidez ou valorização.      PROCESSO SELETIVO     1. Triagem da candidatura.   2. Conversa com People/RH.   3. Entrevista com o Head de Finanças.   4. Conversa com o time de Finanças.   5. Conversa final com os founders.   6. Referências profissionais dos finalistas, com autorização prévia.      CANDIDATURA      Candidate-se pelo botão de candidatura do Linked In. Para assegurar um processo organizado e consistente, as candidaturas devem ser registradas por esse canal.

title: Strategy & operations manager

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.    About the role    At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.    We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.    Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.  Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Implementation specialist
description:
Confira a vaga para Implementation specialist em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Hospitality Implementation Coordinator – Sales & Catering Technology    Location: Brazil — Remote    Employment type: Full-time Contractor    English level: Advanced/Fluent      About the role    We are seeking Hospitality Implementation Coordinators to support the global rollout of a Sales & Catering platform across a large portfolio of hotel properties.      This is a hospitality implementation and project coordination role, not a technical support position. Each coordinator will manage a portfolio of hotels and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the implementation process.      The role is responsible for ensuring that hotel information is collected accurately, implementation activities remain on schedule, required training is completed, and issues are communicated to the appropriate teams. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with hotel properties, regional commercial stakeholders, corporate support teams, external vendors and technical resources.      Hospitality industry experience is the primary requirement. Technical experience is valuable but secondary.      Key responsibilities   Serve as the primary implementation contact for assigned hotel properties. Coordinate hotel-level activities for the rollout of a Sales & Catering platform. Guide properties through implementation milestones, readiness requirements and deployment gates. Ensure required hotel data is accurately gathered, mapped, validated and entered into implementation workbooks and systems of record. Follow up on missing information, corrections and data discrepancies. Track implementation progress, critical deadlines and hotel activation status. Identify delays and risks, take appropriate follow-up action and escalate issues when necessary. Verify that required e-learning modules and training activities are completed before hotels advance to the next implementation phase. Follow up with hotels that are behind schedule or have not completed required activities. Coordinate between hotel properties, corporate support teams, regional commercial leads, external vendors and technical resources. Facilitate consultation calls to ensure that platform configurations reflect each hotel’s operational and commercial needs. Validate required participation agreements, billing arrangements and other property-level deployment requirements. Maintain accurate implementation records, dashboards and status reports. Provide regional stakeholders and program leadership with clear updates on implementation progress. Support early-adopter initiatives and encourage hotels to begin implementation ahead of mandatory deadlines. Help ensure consistent communication and execution across multiple implementation workstreams and hotel properties.    Required qualifications   At least three years of experience in the travel or hospitality industry. Strong understanding of hotel operations and the impact that technology changes can have on property teams. Experience working in or closely with hotel sales, catering, groups, events or commercial teams. Advanced or fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong project coordination, organization and timeline-management abilities. Ability to manage multiple hotel properties, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong relationship-building and influencing skills. Ability to motivate stakeholders, reinforce deadlines and follow up consistently without direct authority. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving implementation risks. Emotional intelligence, self-awareness and cultural sensitivity. Confidence working with spreadsheets, implementation workbooks, dashboards, presentations and project-tracking tools. Ability to work independently within a remote and internationally distributed team.    Preferred qualifications   Experience with Delphi, Delphi FDC, Amadeus Sales & Event Management or another hotel Sales & Catering platform. Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) or other hotel technology implementations. Salesforce experience. Previous involvement in hotel technology rollouts, system migrations, hotel openings or property conversions. Experience supporting implementations across multiple hotel properties or regions. Experience coordinating hotel teams, vendors and technical resources. University degree in hospitality, business, project management or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.    Ideal candidate    The ideal candidate understands hotel operations and has experience working with hotel sales, catering, groups or events teams. They recognize the operational disruption that a new system can create and can guide hotel teams through change with empathy, organization and accountability.      They are comfortable managing deadlines, following up persistently, maintaining accurate records and communicating with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. They do not need to be a technical specialist, but they should be confident working alongside technical teams and learning hotel technology platforms.      This role does not include   Technical product support or software troubleshooting. Software development or system engineering. Product enhancement or feature-request management. Product testing or quality assurance. Ownership of software defects or technical product issues.

A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.      Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.      Missão do Cargo    Supervisor de Manutenção – Utilidades é responsável por garantir a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança dos sistemas de utilidades da planta (caldeiras, compressores, sistemas de refrigeração, energia elétrica, vapor, ar comprimido, água industrial e potável, entre outros), assegurando o atendimento contínuo às demandas produtivas com foco em segurança, eficiência energética, conformidade legal e controle de custos.      Principais Responsabilidades   • Alinhar as estratégias de manutenção de utilidades com as prioridades do negócio e com os pilares de Excelência Operacional.   • Supervisionar e liderar a execução das atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva dos sistemas de utilidades, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, qualidade técnica e segurança.   • Assegurar alta disponibilidade operacional dos sistemas críticos de utilidades, minimizando riscos de impacto à produção.   • Gerenciar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) como disponibilidade, MTBF, MTTR, consumo energético e custos de manutenção.   • Atuar na análise de falhas e conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA), garantindo a implementação efetiva de ações corretivas e preventivas.   • Garantir conformidade com normas regulamentadoras aplicáveis (NR-10, NR-12, NR-13, entre outras), além de requisitos ambientais e de segurança.   • Supervisionar contratos e prestadores de serviço relacionados à área de utilidades.   • Controlar orçamento da área, buscando otimização de custos sem comprometer confiabilidade e segurança.   • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, eficiência energética e redução de perdas.   • Desenvolver e capacitar tecnicamente a equipe, promovendo cultura de segurança, disciplina operacional e melhoria contínua.   • Atuar em conjunto com Produção, Segurança, Qualidade e Engenharia para garantir estabilidade operacional da planta.      Requisitos   • Graduação Completa em Engenharias: Elétrica, Mecânica e Automação industrial.   • Desejável especialização nas áreas de gestão de ativos ou engenharia de confiabilidade.   • Experiência anterior em rotina de fábrica com atuação em sistemas de gestão de manutenção.   • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de geração e distribuição de utilidades industriais (vapor, ar comprimido, energia elétrica, refrigeração e água industrial).   • Experiência com gestão de manutenção preventiva e preditiva.   • Conhecimento em análise de falhas e confiabilidade.   • Conhecimento em legislação técnica e normas regulamentadoras aplicáveis. (Desejável)   • Experiência com SAP módulo PM ou outro sistema de gestão de manutenção (CMMS). (Desejável)   • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos, hidráulicos e P& ID.   • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e controle orçamentário.      Descrição da Empresa      A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

title: Copywriter
description:

A @arquiteturacomlucas é uma empresa de marca pessoal e educação no setor de arquitetura e design de interiores, que faz parte do grupo Galy Group – a vaga consiste em demandas das empresas do grupo.      nós ajudamos arquitetos a empreenderem e construírem escritórios lucrativos, previsíveis e escaláveis.      Acreditamos que o poder do time nos faz ultrapassar qualquer desafio e pensar fora do comum.      Não nos apegamos a lugares. Atuamos remotamente de onde e aonde for preciso.      No momento, estamos com a posição de Copywriter Sênior aberta em nosso time.      Home office – período integral      Buscamos um profissional altamente analítico, orientado por dados e técnicas, com experiência comprovada em criativos para infoprodutos, VSL e afins, capaz de escalar campanhas com foco em aquisição, lucratividade e previsibilidade. Requisitos e Qualificações     Escrever copies para criativos de anúncios , principalmente Meta Ads e outras plataformas de mídia paga. Criar roteiros de anúncios em vídeo , incluindo UGC, VSL curta, depoimentos, advertoriais e criativos diretos. Escrever e estruturar VSLs de vendas . Desenvolver diferentes ângulos de comunicação para uma mesma oferta. Criar hooks, headlines e aberturas para aumentar retenção e CTR dos anúncios. Pesquisar profundamente dores, desejos, objeções, crenças e linguagem do público-alvo . Analisar comentários, reviews, concorrentes, fóruns e conteúdos para identificar novos insights de copy . Criar Big Ideas, mecanismos únicos e conceitos centrais para campanhas. Escrever variações de criativos para realização de testes A/B . Criar novas versões de anúncios vencedores, explorando diferentes hooks, histórias, promessas e abordagens. Criar roteiros indicando cenas, cortes, textos na tela, provas e elementos necessários para cada anúncio. Fazer análise de criativos concorrentes e identificar padrões de comunicação que estão sendo utilizados no mercado. Criar e manter um banco de hooks, ângulos, headlines, objeções e ideias de anúncios . Escrever landing pages e páginas de vendas quando necessário para complementar os funis. Criar copies para upsell, downsell, order bump e checkout . Escrever sequências de e-mails e mensagens de recuperação/conversão quando necessário. Revisar continuamente as VSLs e anúncios existentes buscando aumentar taxa de conversão e escala das campanhas . Participar do planejamento de novos produtos e ofertas, ajudando na construção da promessa, posicionamento e argumento de venda . Transformar pesquisas, cases e resultados de clientes em provas e argumentos persuasivos para anúncios e VSLs . Trabalhar com alto volume de produção e testes, buscando constantemente novos criativos vencedores e novas oportunidades de escala . Escrever roteiros de conteúdos orgânicos seguindo Estratégia de Conteúdo definida em linha editorial.     Modelo de trabalho: Remoto.      Remuneração: Fixo .      O que esperamos de você:      Você não será apenas alguém que “só” escreve. Procuramos um profissional que pense como dono do negócio, participe da estratégia, questione, proponha melhorias e tenha obsessão por performance. Queremos alguém que enxergue mídia paga como uma alavanca de crescimento da empresa, e não apenas como operação.

description:

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Sobre a função O(A) Entrevistador(a) é responsável pela coleta de informações em domicílios participantes dos painéis da empresa, contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade dos dados utilizados por nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas. Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, organizados e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal para atuar em atividades de campo, seguindo padrões de qualidade e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa. Principais responsabilidades Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, treinamentos e orientações conduzidos pela supervisão e coordenação. Ler, compreender e aplicar corretamente os manuais, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos relacionados à coleta de dados. Manter todos os materiais e equipamentos de trabalho atualizados e em boas condições de uso (dispositivo Android, formulários, identificadores de amostras, roteiros de visita e materiais de apoio). Recrutar e integrar novos domicílios ao Painel de Consumidores, quando necessário. Gerenciar a carteira de domicílios sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo o correto acompanhamento dos participantes e mantendo um relacionamento cordial e colaborativo com as famílias. Realizar visitas domiciliares periódicas (semanais ou quinzenais), conforme roteiro definido, cumprindo rigorosamente os procedimentos de coleta. Entregar/enviar comunicados e materiais informativos aos participantes do painel. Acompanhar e auxiliar solicitações de resgate de recompensas de acordo com a pontuação acumulada pelos participantes. Retornar aos domicílios sempre que necessário para corrigir informações, complementar dados ou esclarecer dúvidas. Atualizar continuamente o cadastro dos moradores, registrando alterações como entrada ou saída de residentes, nascimento de crianças e outras mudanças relevantes. Manter atualizadas as informações sobre animais de estimação e bens de consumo do domicílio. Realizar a atualização anual do censo domiciliar, garantindo a consistência e integridade das informações cadastradas. Transmitir os dados coletados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Executar pesquisas especiais e projetos específicos quando designado pela empresa. Perfil desejado Ensino médio completo. Boa comunicação verbal e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas. Cordialidade, empatia e postura profissional durante as visitas domiciliares. Capacidade de despertar confiança e engajamento dos participantes da pesquisa. Organização e atenção aos detalhes na coleta e registro das informações. Comprometimento com prazos, qualidade dos dados e cumprimento de procedimentos. Voz clara, audível e boa dicção. Responsabilidade na utilização da identificação da empresa, mantendo o crachá visível durante toda a execução das entrevistas. Diferenciais Experiência com atendimento ao público, pesquisas de campo ou visitas domiciliares. Familiaridade com o uso de dispositivos móveis e aplicativos de coleta de dados. Facilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma, seguindo rotas e cronogramas definidos. Numerator is a data company transforming how consumers and markets are understood. Powered by advanced technology and proprietary, zero-party purchase and survey data from more than one million households, Numerator provides visibility into consumer behavior and attitudes across consumer goods, retail, restaurants, tech and media, management consulting, institutional investors, and the public sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Numerator drives decisions at the world's largest and fastest-growing companies in more than 50 countries.

Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e validações para apoiar decisões de design. Criar soluções de UX e UI, considerando interação, arquitetura da informação e qualidade visual. Trabalhar em parceria com Produto, Tecnologia, Dados e demais áreas na definição e evolução das soluções. Defender decisões de design com clareza, utilizando dados, pesquisa e argumentos de negócio. Domínio de UX, UI, Design Visual e Design de Interação. Experiência com pesquisa qualitativa, entrevistas e testes de usabilidade. Experiência trabalhando em ambientes multidisciplinares e próximos de Produto e Tecnologia. Autonomia, senso de ownership e capacidade de conduzir problemas complexos. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de apresentar e defender decisões de design. Proficiência em Figma. Familiaridade com Notion e Miro. Portfólio que demonstre processo, decisões e resultados, além das interfaces finais. Familiaridade com processos de Product Design utilizando Inteligência Artificial.    Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver: Experiência com produtos de grande escala ou alta complexidade. Experiência com experimentação e uso de métricas para tomada de decisão. Experiência utilizando IA de forma prática para potencializar o processo de design. Interesse em compartilhar conhecimento e contribuir para o desenvolvimento do time. Perfil provocativo, curioso e orientado a criar experiências cada vez melhores para os clientes. title: Brazil user research consultant - beauty & imaging (3-month contract)
description:
Confira a vaga para Brazil user research consultant - beauty & imaging (3-month contract) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Remote | Project-based | September–November 2026      Why We Need You:    Meitu is the team behind Beauty Plus, Air Brush, and Magic Pic, and we're digging into how beauty and imaging professionals in Brazil think about aesthetics, makeup, and visual expression. This project is all about talking to retouchers, photographers, makeup artists, and medical aesthetics practitioners to understand what actually resonates in the Brazilian market. We need someone based in Brazil who can help us listen, translate, and make sense of what users really mean.      What You'll Do:   · Support 15+ user interviews with participants mostly in Brazil and a few in the US; provide Portuguese-English translation and, once trained, run interviews independently at times that work for Brazilian users.   · Help the team understand the local context behind what people say, including cultural cues, implied meaning, and the way Brazilian users naturally talk about beauty and imagery.   · Write a clear summary after each interview and help with participant scheduling or follow-ups when needed.   · Review Brazilian Portuguese questionnaire copy to make sure it sounds natural, flag anything confusing or unnatural, and do a basic readability pass on any English versions.   · Gather and organize desk research on Brazilian beauty and imagery culture from Tik Tok, Instagram, You Tube, Whats App, and Kwai, then turn observations into clear local insights.      Who You Are:   · You're currently living, studying, or working in Brazil and you get how Brazilian users create, talk, and express themselves online.   · You're fluent in Portuguese with a strong feel for natural Brazilian Portuguese wording, and you can communicate with the project team in English or Chinese.   · You're familiar with the social platforms Brazilian users actually use: Tik Tok, Instagram, You Tube, Whats App, and Kwai.   · You're interested in or already close to medical aesthetics, makeup, photography, or another visual field.   · You can organize research notes, summarize findings, and pull out patterns without losing local nuance.   · You can maintain relatively stable availability from September to November while the project is running.      Even Better If You:   · You're bilingual in Portuguese and Chinese.

Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.    Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.      Role Purpose    This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.      Required Skills & Experience Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Net Suite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders Strong written communication skills and attention to detail Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support  Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements  Billing & Invoice Support Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests  Data Quality & Master Data Management Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, Net Suite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections  Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs  Reporting Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team) Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting  Service Expectations Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Segment manager
description:

Position Details    Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager    Department: Sales — Latin America    Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM    Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region    Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory      Role Objective    Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.      Primary Responsibilities    Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.  Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.  Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.  Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.  CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.    Qualifications & Experience    What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.  Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).  What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.    About Quectel    Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.    Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R& D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.    Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.    Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Remote real estate lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote real estate lawyer - brazil em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai agent engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite    First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research    coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.      The role    We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the    evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.    The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and    inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a    person reviews before anything happens with it.    Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,    traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.    You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've    shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea    whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.      What you'll do   • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,    included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,    Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.   • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems    are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.   • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect    entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.   • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to    Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.    Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.   • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence    signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.   • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.    Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.   • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as    regression tests.   • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt    strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.   • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means    generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will    eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.   • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to    you.      Required Qualifications:   • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real    users touched.   • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about    a multi-step run.   • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and    turned them into something an agent can call reliably.   • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against    a structured source of truth.   • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.   • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and    what to do about it.   • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question    being asked instead of a nearby one.   • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval    for them.   • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.   • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the    furthest east we can go.    You might currently be titled    AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI    Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI    Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll    go on what you've shipped.      Preferred Qualifications:   • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.   • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI    Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.   • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.   • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.   • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.      This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Analista de estratÉgia e operaÇÕes
description:
